purpose: Test whether gravity-independent parameter packages can regenerate morphology-diverse spiral baryonic maps and preserve formula-predicted speed fields before any observed velocity target is unsealed.
selectionRule: Evaluate every frozen tier on all four development maps and choose the lowest-complexity tier that passes every morphology, mass, compression, 3D projection, and formula-transport gate. If none passes, report failure rather than selecting the least-bad tier.

verticalPriors.interpretation: Declared projection-equivalent priors, not a unique recovery of true depth.

formulaTransportFixtures.purpose: Measure whether the same fixed formula gives the same prediction on the observed baryonic map and its generated twin. This is not comparison with an observed speed.

claimBoundary: P0742 can show that a fake twin retains the observed baryonic structure closely enough for a formula to make nearly the same prediction on both maps.
P0742 cannot show that either prediction matches real stellar or gas speeds because every observed velocity target remains sealed.
The formula fixtures are fixed diagnostic rulers and do not enter extraction or tier selection except through a preregistered transport-fidelity gate.
Development selection must be frozen before validation and holdout maps are opened.
